title: Case definitions
summary: For a source-authored plan, export cases from a clean merged source using its declared target; retain the exporter's full source_revision with cases. Sync that export to bind the plan or recover, then reread and check the plan against source. Once bound, a plan whose cases the Yoke build generates converges on server boot to that build's cases and commit, moving only forward; a failure keeps the cases and logs qa_plan_source_convergence_failed with its recovery. A release run freezes its plans at start, so before a stage first materializes a frozen source-bound plan it takes the saved cases when their source descends from the frozen one and the candidate carries it; otherwise it keeps the frozen cases and logs qa_frozen_plan_kept. A plan frozen while unbound keeps its frozen cases for that run after a later bind. Existing requirements, runs and evidence keep their admitted copies; requirements_behind_plan names the refresh/rematerialize recovery. Older engines may refuse qa_plan_source_binding_unavailable before writing.
recipes: yoke qa plan-cases sync --project P --plan-id N --cases-file SOURCE_EXPORT --json
verification: The canonical installer-campaign maintenance home owns export, boot convergence and post-sync checks. Source help, boot convergence and release refresh tests inspected; no saved plan, requirement or execution changed.
